versions.changelog:
No functional or content changes in this version.

- No file changes detected.
- Version number and reference documentation remain unchanged.

Initial release of the canonical data directory map for OpenClaw Greek Accounting.

- Defines a single, authoritative directory structure for all file and data storage.
- Standardizes naming conventions, paths, and identifier formats (e.g., AFM, dates).
- Introduces `/data/memory/` for agent episodic memory, logs, and proposals.
- Outlines detailed usage policies and directory purposes for every main subtree.
- Requires all future skills to conform to this map—no exceptions without version updates.
